title: City of the Dead The Dark Hauntings of Charleston
includes: Every tour is different since we tailor the tours to our guests preferences.
Hear the about the hauntings of Charleston from the City's Best Storytellers, Adam and Darian
Refunds for 1 or 2 Star Reviews. This is a 5 Star tour, "Review Bombing" will not be rewarded (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: You choose the path, you choose the tour! Every one of our tours are based on our guests requests and preferences. Will you choose pirates or gangsters, serial killers or cursed lovers? For 90 minutes, you will be led to the most haunted places in one of America's oldest cities. Along the way, you can choose to visit the city's most haunted hotel, the most haunted restaurant, or even the most famous graveyard. You can visit alleyways and forgotten places, while hearing tales of the restless inhabitants from the Holy City's best storytellers. We are the only tour company in Charleston that actually creates the tour based on our guests interests and requests. What fear will you choose?
